The road is well-paved and narrow.
Most of the roads are maintained fairly well, there are a few potholes but all are small and easily avoidable, even in a pack.
The hairpins that grace the mountains climbing out of the desert are remarkably tight.
The draw for this ride is that it is a fun curvy ride.
